learning_outcomes.text: Provide basic training in communication systems and networks, allowing students to understand the available technology and methods to overcome its limitations.

teaching_methods: Lectures with presentation and discussion of course topics using audiovisual resources complemented with the resolution of illustrative exercises
Laboratory classes using educational kits and software tools
Case study presentations by industrial partners
bibliography: Ali Grami, Introduction to Digital Communications, Elsevier Academic Press, 2016.
A. Bruce Carlson, P. Crilly. Communication Systems, 5th edition, McGraw-Hill, 2009.
W. Stallings. Data and Computer Communications, 10th edition, Pearson, 2014.
B. P. Lathi, Z. Ding. Modern Digital and Analog Communication Systems, 4th edition, Oxford University Press, 2009.
J. G. Proakis, M. Salehi. Fundamentals of Communication Systems, 2nd edition, Pearson, 2014.
B. Kumar, Communication System Laboratory, CRC Press, 2016.
degree: Licenciatura em Engenharia Eletrotécnica e de Computadores (LEEC)
